description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git behavior related to line ending normalization, merge conflicts involving text=auto attribute, and file renormalization scenarios. It sets up repository state, performs various merge operations, and checks for expected outcomes.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after converting CR and ASCII NUL characters to a placeholder, checks for differences, and cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: fuzz_conflict
methods.description: Fuzzily matches conflict markers in a file by sed-based pattern, used to compare conflict files with expected patterns.
